findings.title: TLS certificate validity
findings.evidence: Valid certificate issued by trusted CA, expires in 85 days
findings.explanation: Active TLS certificate is properly chained and unexpired

findings.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security header
findings.evidence: Strict-Transport-Security header is absent in response
findings.explanation: Without HSTS, initial connections may be susceptible to downgrade attacks
findings.recommendation: Deploy Strict-Transport-Security header with appropriate max-age

findings.title: Cookie Secure attribute enforcement
findings.evidence: All set cookies carry Secure attribute
findings.explanation: Browser cookies are restricted to HTTPS transmission only

findings.title: Sender Policy Framework record
findings.explanation: SPF record designates legitimate sending hosts

limitations: Audits single landing page headers and public DNS only
Does not spider internal authenticated endpoints
